status: Platform Administration native Holding migration-run command and Next operations ingress cutover implemented and PostgreSQL-qualified; the owner remains partial because the shared composition router assembly, native configuration and browser verification are outside this slice.

scope.command: Run the shipped Holding write migrations through the runtime locked runner, persist a Control receipt with actor, assignment, Holding, reason, applied counts, result and CAS version, and replay the retained result by idempotency key.
scope.reads: The owner operations snapshot continues to read each configured Holding migration state through inspect_migrations; no cross-Holding SQL or fallback was added.
scope.ingress: Owner-local POST /api/v1/platform/operations/migrate plus the existing operations read, provision and recover routes now delegate to the native Platform Administration transport. Every route fails closed with 503 when ERPX_NATIVE_PLATFORM_ADMIN_CONFIG is unset.

coverage.domainAndApplication: 20 Rust lib tests passed. Six new cases cover migration authority/track/Holding identity, digest binding, replay of succeeded receipts, fail-closed running/failed/incomplete receipts, and no store call before validation.
postgres: holding_migrations_run_once_with_control_receipt_and_holdings_isolation: applied_before=0, applied_after>0, pending empty, persisted result_json/version=2, replay returns the same result without a second row, changed reason returns IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, auditor FORBIDDEN, invalid track VALIDATION_FAILED, unknown Holding NOT_FOUND, h002 stays unmigrated, and the operations snapshot reads the applied state back.

a_failed_holding_migration_is_retained_as_failed_without_a_success_result: an injected failing migration file leaves status=failed, result_json NULL, a bounded non-empty error, applied_after>0, version=2 and a MIGRATION_FAILED replay.

a_rolled_back_migration_finalize_never_claims_success: a Control trigger aborts the succeeded CAS update; the receipt remains running at version=1 with no result/error/finished_at, the command returns Unavailable and the replay returns MIGRATION_IN_PROGRESS.

actual_router_reads_and_provisions_over_postgres_with_target_and_key_negatives now posts the native migrate route and verifies 200 with appliedBefore==appliedAfter for an already-migrated Holding; the foreign-origin request remains 403.
coverage.http: The owner router adds /api/v1/platform/operations/migrate with the same exact Host/Origin, Idempotency-Key, JSON content type, 64 KiB body limit and bounded business-error mapping. The request envelope carries holdingId separately from the recovery domain input so existing recovery receipt digests remain replayable.
coverage.nextTransport: 9 vitest cases passed. Two new cases cover the keyed migrate command path/origin/key/body and invalid applied counts, plus absence of ERPX_NATIVE_PLATFORM_ADMIN_CONFIG returning undefined (fail closed) and an invalid configuration rejecting.

cargoTestPlatformAdministration.breakdown: lib 20, agent evidence unit 10, agent evidence http 6, agent evidence postgres 3, legal release 2, platform administration postgres 6

cargoClippy.note: A full --no-deps is required because concurrent uncommitted erpx-server-organization code currently fails clippy with four unrelated lints; this slice did not modify that owner.

checks.structure: blocked by concurrent uncommitted customer_360.rust-customer-timeline.unit catalogue verification input; no Platform Administration layout error was reported.

sharedCompositionSchemaDelta.composition: none; the owner router and typed public ports are exported for the main agent to assemble in src/composition
sharedCompositionSchemaDelta.schema: none; the command reuses migrations/postgres/control/0015_platform_migration_runs.sql and its existing version/result/error columns

legacy.removedFromRuntime: The four Platform operations Next routes no longer import the retained TypeScript summarizePlatformOperations, provisionHolding, recoverDeadLetterJob or runHoldingMigrations implementations.
legacy.retained: packages/server-platform_administration/src/adapters/operations.ts keeps the TypeScript implementations and the public platform-operations export for non-native integration tests and the executive presentation helper. Removal is gated on composition wiring and replacing those retained test/oracle consumers.

limits: The shared Rust composition backend is not wired because src/composition is outside this subagent's allowed scope. The Next routes therefore return 503 until ERPX_NATIVE_PLATFORM_ADMIN_CONFIG and a serving owner router exist.
No browser journey was run. The route cutover is typechecked and transport-tested only.

Migration execution is atomic per migration file, not atomic across the whole run. A failure records the persisted failed receipt with the actual applied count and a bounded error; earlier committed files are not rolled back.

No schema change was made; the existing platform_migration_runs row is the durable audit/receipt record. The Control database has no outbox table and the command does not invent cross-owner Holding audit writes.

The feature-admin routes consume the existing @erpx/feature-platform_administration public lib subpath. No package manifest or lockfile was changed because dependency updates are prohibited in this slice; Bun workspace resolution and all affected typechecks pass.
No workflow is marked verified or merged; docs/status was intentionally not edited.
next: Assemble platform_router with the real Account session/Platform assignment/Holding resolver in src/composition, provide ERPX_NATIVE_PLATFORM_ADMIN_CONFIG, then run the authorized browser journey and update the owner register/acceptance evidence.
